Wrapper function to generate NCVis parameters

Source: R/params-generated.R
params_ncvis.Rd

NCVis runs noise-contrastive Hogwild! SGD on the unweighted kNN graph. The defaults are the NCVis+ ones: PCA start, a large learning rate and 10 negatives per edge. Only reproducible at a fixed seed on one thread.

Usage

params_ncvis(
  n_epochs = 50L,
  n_negative = 10,
  lr = 2,
  lr_q = 1,
  init = c("pca", "random", "ncvis"),
  init_scale = 10,
  randomised = FALSE
)

Arguments

n_epochs

Integer. Number of optimisation epochs. Defaults to 50L.

n_negative

Numeric. Mean number of negative samples per edge. Defaults to 10.0.

lr

Numeric. Learning rate of the embedding. Defaults to 2.0.

lr_q

Numeric. Learning rate of the noise normalisation constant Q. Defaults to 1.0.

init

String. Embedding initialisation method. "ncvis" is the original NCVis start: uniform noise smoothed over the kNN graph in 20 passes. One of c("pca", "random", "ncvis"). Defaults to "pca".

init_scale

Numeric. Standard deviation of the first axis of the initial layout. The other axes are scaled by the same factor. Defaults to 10.0.

randomised

Boolean. Use randomised SVD for PCA initialisation. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named list with the following elements:

  • n_epochs - Integer. Number of optimisation epochs. Defaults to 50L.

  • n_negative - Numeric. Mean number of negative samples per edge. Defaults to 10.0.

  • lr - Numeric. Learning rate of the embedding. Defaults to 2.0.

  • lr_q - Numeric. Learning rate of the noise normalisation constant Q. Defaults to 1.0.

  • init - String. Embedding initialisation method. "ncvis" is the original NCVis start: uniform noise smoothed over the kNN graph in 20 passes. One of c("pca", "random", "ncvis"). Defaults to "pca".

  • init_scale - Numeric. Standard deviation of the first axis of the initial layout. The other axes are scaled by the same factor. Defaults to 10.0.

  • randomised - Boolean. Use randomised SVD for PCA initialisation. Defaults to FALSE.

References

Artemenkov & Panov, WWW, 2020; Pedersen, NCVis+, 2026 (https://github.com/SeanPedersen/ncvis-plus)
